title: Managed Artwork PostgreSQL Parity
problem: Managed Artwork was SQLite-only when M62 PostgreSQL readiness split it out to avoid partial runtime enablement.

continue_policy.notes: MAPG is complete. PostgreSQL now has Managed Artwork repository parity and runtime capability enablement. Future work should open a separate lane for PostgreSQL CI hardening, image-processing policy changes, or artifact-store backend expansion.
